scripts.dev: bun "$(ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); if [ -f "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts" ]; then echo "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; else echo "$ROOT/oss/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; fi)" watch-bun ./src/server.ts
scripts.server:build: bun run check-types && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288 ncc build ./src/server.ts -o ./dist --source-map --external bun:sqlite --external bun --transpile-only && bun run sentry:sourcemaps:if-token
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: (sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org metorial --project mte-subspace-worker ./dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org metorial --project mte-subspace-worker ./dist) || true
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps:if-token: sh -c 'if [ -n "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then bun run sentry:sourcemaps; else echo "Skipping Sentry sourcemap upload"; fi'
